predecessor.verdict: NEGATIVE - frozen permanently, never to be altered or rerun
why_this_campaign_differs: V1 sampled regular 15-second timestamps; this campaign evaluates sparse economic events only.
V1 evaluated taker execution only; this campaign evaluates maker and taker as competing actions.
V1 used a 24h L2 archive; this campaign requires a continuous 60-90 day multi-venue archive.
V1 did not gate horizons on cost feasibility; this campaign refuses infeasible horizons up front.

family_independence.note: Each family carries its own protocol section, trial registry, model, result and promotion decision. A family that fails is closed; its budget does not transfer.

execution.fee_basis_note: Binance perpetual fees are a rate on NOTIONAL. The Polymarket contract-price formula rate*p*(1-p) is INVALID here and must never be used; it clamps p to [0,1] and silently returns zero fees at a 60000 price.

horizon_viability_gate.measure_definition: P(|endpoint move over h| > round_trip_cost). The share of anchor timestamps at which a position held exactly h and closed at the endpoint would clear the assumed round trip, GIVEN PERFECT DIRECTION.
horizon_viability_gate.measure_is_not: A profitability ceiling. It excludes maximum favourable excursion, stop/target exits, variable holding periods, spread and depth changes, funding, partial fills, maker fill probability and adverse selection. It screens ONE execution assumption: fixed horizon, endpoint exit.
horizon_viability_gate.why_lower_bound: Anchors within a day overlap and are strongly autocorrelated, so row counts vastly overstate independent sample size. Point estimates are reported but never admit. This is load-bearing: 60s maker passes on the point estimate (21.46%) and fails on LB95 (19.59%).

sensitivity_only_scenarios.maker_4bps: SENSITIVITY_ONLY_NOT_ADMISSIBLE - assumes an all-in 4bps maker cost that is achieved AND filled. Cannot admit a horizon and cannot support promotion until queue-aware forward evidence demonstrates 4bps is actually attainable net of fill probability, queue position, partial fills, adverse selection, cancel latency and taker fallback.

measured_evidence.dataset_role_note: These days SELECTED the horizons and cost scenarios. They can never serve as untouched final evidence for those same choices. The future 60-90 day qualifying collection is the first untouched test.
measured_evidence.method: 1s last-price grid (last aggTrade at or before each second boundary); endpoint move from second t to second t+h within one UTC day; anchors with no eligible endpoint second are EXCLUDED, never carried forward; horizons never cross a day file boundary; endpoint uses the last trade at or before t+h, never the first trade after it.

sample.manifest_note: sha256 over the sorted list of sampled day identifiers; full list in raw_output

measured_evidence.regime_note: The low 30s taker clearance rate was reproduced in sampled days from every calendar year 2023-2026 (1.94%, 3.36%, 2.08%, 2.60%). This supports broad temporal robustness; calling it structural remains a well-supported hypothesis rather than a proven property, since 129 of 1,286 available days were sampled.
measured_evidence.consequence: 30s, 60s and 180s TAKER are refused (LB95 2.08%, 5.12%, 15.29%). 30s and 60s MAKER are refused (LB95 10.80%, 19.59%). PROFIT_CAMPAIGN_V1 traded a 30s horizon at 12bps every 15 seconds, so ~97.5% of its anchors could not clear cost even with perfect direction. That makes its measured profit factor of 0.0000 across 374 trades economically unsurprising for an indiscriminate system; it does not mathematically force it, since a sufficiently selective signal could in principle trade only the eligible fraction.
stated_limitations: Endpoint move only - a take-profit strategy can capture excursions that round-trip back, so these rates understate what a variable-exit strategy could reach.

abs(move) screen - the terminal version must compute perfect-long and perfect-short net returns separately through executable ask/bid with fees on actual entry and exit notionals, rather than treating spread and fee arithmetic as one constant.
1-second grid - sub-second structure is invisible at this resolution and no sub-second claim may rest on it.

admissible_horizons_seconds._derivation: NOT hand-written. Every entry is a horizon whose clearance LB95 under the PRIMARY cost scenario is >= minimum_clearance_lb95. selftest asserts these lists agree with the gate on every horizon, so the two can never drift apart.

taker_excluded.180: LB95 15.29% (point 16.97%) - a near miss is a miss; the floor is not moved to admit it

maker_excluded.60: LB95 19.59% (point 21.46%) - passes on the point estimate, FAILS on the lower bound. This is precisely why admission uses LB95.

selected_horizons_seconds._derivation: Admissibility is necessary but not sufficient. Admitting every eligible horizon multiplies trials and creates selection flexibility, so the grid is capped at three per execution style, chosen deterministically as the shortest, middle (index (n-1)//2) and longest eligible horizon. No discretion.

TOUCH_PROXY.note: price touched the level; diagnostic only, never sufficient for promotion

TRADE_THROUGH.note: minimum credible label - a trade printed through the resting price

QUEUE_ESTIMATED.note: promotion-quality - queue position modelled from displayed size ahead and consumption

stopping_rule.condition: If all four families fail their promotion gates on the untouched period, BTCUSDT perpetual direction at retail cost structure is recorded as not tractable by this program, and no V3 may reuse these families with adjusted parameters.
stopping_rule.rationale: A framework that is good at rejecting invites an unbounded V2/V3/V4 sequence, each explaining the last failure. The stopping condition is preregistered alongside the promotion gates.

prohibitions: Do not alter, rerun, retune or re-report PROFIT_CAMPAIGN_V1.
Do not blend alpha families or fall back between them.
Do not forward-fill across a recorder gap.
Do not claim sub-second latency evidence from batched observations.
Do not promote on TOUCH_PROXY alone.
Do not headline accuracy or win rate.
Do not use the Polymarket contract-price fee formula for Binance perpetuals.
Do not change any parameter after the untouched period is opened.
Do not place live orders, promote to paper, or modify production models.
